column2: Paano mag-rank ng rows gamit ang window function?
column4: SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank FROM employees;

column2: Paano mag-partition ng data gamit ang PARTITION BY?
column4: SELECT department, name, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) FROM employees;

column2: Ano ang pagkakaiba ng RANK at DENSE_RANK?
column4: RANK: may gaps (1,1,3). DENSE_RANK: walang gaps (1,1,2). Piliin dependi sa kailangan.
